name: RisuNest
subtitle: RisuNest for iOS
description: Unsigned iOS releases of RisuNest. Sign and install with your preferred sideloading app.

apps.name: RisuNest
apps.localizedDescription: An AI chat application with multiple providers, characters, themes, plugins, and advanced memory systems.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan a QR code you choose to connect RisuNest.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connect to a local AI provider or RisuNest sync server that you choose.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Fixed RisuAI account backup and restore not working.
- Fixed restore problems with some backup files and improved restore failure notices.
- Fixed backup and sync issues with external storage such as Google Drive, OneDrive, and GitHub.
- Added a UI and popups that show sync status and errors.
- Added a feature that delays loading plugins until sync has fully finished (prevents plugin data corruption).
- Fixed and improved Sync server synchronization.
- Added CBS parsing for plugins (parseRisuChat).
- Improved plugin storage compatibility (fixed storing Date objects).
- Improved conversation loading performance with long chats or many assets.
- Fixed bugs in automatic input translation, toggle presets, and lorebooks.
- Fixed a bug that could navigate the RisuNest app to an external page.
- Fixed and improved file downloads on all platforms, including plugin file downloads.
- Improved the Windows installer.
- Improved error messages and logging.

- Fixed failures when restoring RisuAI and PocketRisu backups.
- Fixed large backups failing to restore on Android.
- Fixed backups with 200,000 or more assets failing to restore.
- Improved backup restores and Sync/external storage restores to show progress.
- Improved restore and sync performance.
- Fixed toggle changes being saved automatically when using toggle binding.
- Fixed the scroll position jumping when message heights change.
- Added support for Voyage Context 4 embeddings.
- Raised the local plugin storage limit.
- Fixed file selection not working properly on iOS.
- Improved AltStore integration on iOS and fixed signatures not being passed to the IPA file.
- Added multiple profiles on desktop through `--profile=<name>`.
- Added multiple languages and an architecture check to the Windows installer.
- Improved automatic updates, installation, and removal on Windows.

- Improved compatibility with bots, modules, and plugins.
- Improved Lua, script, and UI performance in long chats.
- Added a console log viewer.
- Fixed update links not opening on Android.
- Fixed a sidebar scrolling issue on iOS.
